household.title: Household
household.description: Share accounts, budgets, and goals with the people you live with.

roleDescriptions.owner: Manages everyone in the household and can hand ownership to someone else.
roleDescriptions.admin: Invites and manages members and viewers, and changes shared finances.
roleDescriptions.member: Sees and changes shared accounts, budgets, and goals.
roleDescriptions.viewer: Sees shared finances but can't change anything.

members.heading: Members
members.seats: {used} of {max} places taken, pending invitations included

invite.heading: Invite someone
invite.description: They get their own sign-in and see your shared finances. Accounts you mark as private stay private. Someone who already has an account accepts from the invitation link.
invite.full: Your household has room for {max} people, pending invitations included. Revoke an invitation or remove someone to invite another person.

removeDialog.title: Remove {name}?
removeDialog.description: They lose access to this household right away and are signed out everywhere. The accounts and transactions they added stay with the household, and their linked bank connections are disconnected.

leaveDialog.title: Leave this household?
leaveDialog.description: You lose access to the shared accounts, budgets, and goals, and your linked bank connections are disconnected. This can't be undone.

roleDialog.title: Change {name}'s role
roleDialog.description: The new role applies the next time they open the app.

transferDialog.title: Make {name} the owner?
transferDialog.description: {name} becomes the owner: they manage everyone in the household, you included, and only they can hand ownership on again. You become an admin.

errors.already_household_member: That person is already in this household.
errors.household_full: This household is full. Revoke an invitation or remove someone first.
errors.household_has_data: Your current household already holds accounts or transactions, so it can't join another one yet. Delete them first, or accept with a different account.
errors.household_has_members: Other people share your current household. Hand ownership to one of them, or remove them, before you join another household.
errors.household_owner_required: Only the owner can do that.
errors.household_role_required: Your role doesn't allow that. Ask the owner or an admin.
errors.invite_already_used: This invitation has already been used.
errors.invite_email_mismatch: This invitation is for a different email address than the one you're signed in with.
errors.invite_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.invite_invalid: This invitation link isn't valid. Ask for a new one.

readOnly.title: View-only access
readOnly.description: You can see this household's finances but not change them. Ask the owner or an admin for a different role.

join.greetingGeneric: You've been invited to a {instanceName} household
join.subtitle: Create your account to share accounts, budgets, and goals.
join.signInToAccept: Already have an account? <link>Sign in to accept</link>
join.invalidBody: It may have already been used, revoked, or expired. Ask the person who invited you to send a fresh invite.
join.dataHeading: What happens to your current household
join.dataRequirement: You can join only if your current household has no accounts or transactions.
join.dataStaysBehind: Budgets, categories, rules, and goals you set up there stay behind. They aren't moved.
join.dataYours: Your profile, sign-in, preferences, and devices stay yours.
join.useDifferentAccount: Sign out and use a different account
join.emailMismatchTitle: This invitation is for another email address
join.emailMismatchBody: It was sent to {invited}, but you're signed in as {current}. Sign out, then sign in or create an account with {invited} to accept it.

toast.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

household.loadError: We couldn't load your household. Please try again.
